what_is_absent: A market condition type for a city: the enumerated type MarketConditionType holds REGION, LOCATION, COMPANY_LOCATION and CHANNEL, and none for a city
A market condition type for a storefront: the enumerated type MarketConditionType holds REGION, LOCATION, COMPANY_LOCATION and CHANNEL, and none for a storefront

A market condition type for a group of customers other than a company location, such as a customer segment: the enumerated type MarketConditionType holds REGION, LOCATION, COMPANY_LOCATION and CHANNEL

A setting that caps how many countries a store sells to, or sets when a selling location applies, among WooCommerce's settings pages: Selling location(s) (woocommerce_allowed_countries, S02-WC-018) is one setting for the store, and its two country lists (S02-WC-513, S02-WC-514) offer the countries WooCommerce lists (S02-WC-515); no page caps them or sets a condition on them

A country, region or other place among the properties that define a channel (name, type, platform), and a channel type for a country or region (the types are storefront, marketing, pos, marketplace, custom)
